Title: Azure Scheduler available in United Kingdom

Body.Content:
Azure Scheduler is available in the United Kingdom South (London, England) and United Kingdom West (Cardiff, Wales) regions. The United Kingdom South and West pair is a Scheduler geo-region that is paired for high availability and ensures that data stays within the region.

For more information, visit the Scheduler page. To see all of the available regions and pricing, visit the Scheduler pricing page.
